recovered: Let C and D be categories and F : C ≃ D an equivalence of categories. If (f : X → Z, g : Y → Z) has a pullback (P, π₁, π₂) in C, then (F f, F g) has a pullback (F P, F π₁, F π₂) in D; moreover, F induces an equivalence of categories between pullback cones over (f, g) and (F f, F g).
Standard 1-category context; assumes C, D categories, F : C ≃ D equivalence, f, g morphisms with pullback in C.
F : C ≃ D denotes a categorical equivalence; 'pullback cone' as in Cone (diagram (X → Z ← Y)); F f = F.map f.
